## Remaining Sunday options — freshly rechecked

These are confirmations of choices already covered by the live roundup, not a new campaign.

### Bristol

1. **Bristol Sea Shanty Shout** — Sunday 20 September, 12:00–18:00, Great Eastern Hall, Brunel Square. Free, donations accepted, no booking. The organiser explicitly says it is not on the ship. No numerical child age range is published; family suitability remains an editorial judgement.
   - Source: https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/bristol-sea-shanty-shout
   - Checked: 20 September 2026, 08:37 BST

2. **Docks Heritage Weekend at M Shed** — Sunday 20 September includes historic Port of Bristol films, cargo-handling demonstrations, models and quayside theatre. Crane visits and boat trips are ticketed. The paper-boat workshop was Saturday only and must not be promoted as a Sunday activity.
   - Source: https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/whats-on/m-shed/docks-heritage-weekend/
   - Checked: 20 September 2026, 08:37 BST

3. **Trinity Community Celebration Day** — Sunday 20 September, 12:00–16:00, £0–£3 donation. All ages; under-14s with an adult. Live music, performances, workshops, nature and craft drop-ins. Accessibility requests should go to Trinity.
   - Source: https://www.trinitybristol.org.uk/whats-on/2026/trinitys-community-day-celebration
   - Checked: 20 September 2026, 08:39 BST

4. **Tyntesfield Heritage Open Day** — final free day Sunday 20 September, 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00, no booking. Open to everyone. Sloping paths and loose gravel; mobility shuttle 10:00–17:00.
   - Source: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/bath-bristol/tyntesfield/events/181b773f-1fc7-4a87-8f4b-41c89c2dd4c8
   - Checked: 20 September 2026, 08:39 BST

- **St Margaret's Church Open Doors** — Sunday 20 September, 14:00–17:30, free, no booking. Children's quiz trail. Disabled access is through the porch; tower access is restricted to able-bodied adults and is weather dependent.

### Birmingham

- **Moor Pool Heritage Festival** — Sunday 20 September, 11:00–15:00, free, no booking. Family crafts, LEGO, trails, glitter tattoos, music and sports tasters. The estate is undulating, with some uneven surfaces and steps; Moor Pool Hall has side wheelchair access.
  - Source: https://birminghamheritageweek.co.uk/event/moor-pool-heritage-festival/

## New Bristol lead — next weekend

### Ma-ad Science Mayhem, Bristol Dockyards

- Runs **26 September–1 November 2026**.
- Shaun the Sheep science challenges are spread across the site, indoors and outdoors.
- Included in general admission or the Afternoon Saver; it is not a free event.
- General admission online: child £14.50, adult £22; on the door: child £16.50, adult £25.
- Afternoon Saver from 14:30: £13 online or £15 on the door.
- Full-price general admission is valid for return visits for a year.
- Under-14s must be accompanied by an adult.
- No numerical recommended age range is published for the challenge itself.
- Sources:
  - https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/ma-ad-science-mayhem
  - https://www.bristoldockyards.org/tickets
- Checked: 20 September 2026, 08:38 BST
